interactions.label: Talk with Mira
interactions.feedback: Mira asks how your classes are going and tells you about a strange neighborhood post she saw online.

interactions.label: Join Mira for lunch
interactions.feedback: You share lunch and compare plans for the rest of the day. Mira mentions that the apartment-block rumor has been circulating for weeks.

interactions.label: Talk with Noah
interactions.feedback: Noah talks about his training session and asks whether you are free this weekend.

interactions.label: Talk with Sera
interactions.feedback: Sera asks what you have been studying and recommends a quieter place to work.

interactions.label: Ask about response services
interactions.feedback: Ms. An explains that the company verifies reports before dispatching a field team. She gives you a public contact card and advises you not to enter an unsafe building alone.
